name: OVERKILL
desc:
Fast-paced deckbuilder shooter where you stack upgrades to become stronger each round.

Compete in teams, duels, or free-for-all matches — the first to 5 points wins!

👍 If you enjoy the game, please give it a like! It's the easiest way to support us.

👥 Join your friends for extra rewards!
💬 Chat with the developers & community in our server!
⚠️ Exploiters will be permanently banned!
